title: Finite-Field Heisenberg-Weil Mixed Model
body_html:
Finite-Field Heisenberg-Weil Mixed Model

Let \(W\) be a finite symplectic space and \(W_C\) a nonzero totally isotropic subspace. With \[ W_0=W_C^\perp/W_C, \] the finite-field Heisenberg-Weil representation is the unique extension of the induced module from \[ P(W_C)\ltimes H(W_C^\perp) \] whose \(P(W_C)\)-factor is the quadratic determinant character \(\chi_{W_C}\) times the Weil representation of \(W_0\). The \(W_C\)-invariant vectors are isomorphic to the Weil representation of \(W_0\), again with the \(\chi_{W_C}\) twist.
proof_html:
Extraction

The paper cites Gérardin for this model and uses it repeatedly to compute invariant spaces under isotropic subspaces in the one-block proof.
